faqItems.question: What is StarsPaymee and how does it work?
faqItems.answer: StarsPaymee is a service for buying Telegram Stars, Telegram Premium and Telegram Gifts in Uzbekistan. You order through the @StarsPaymee_bot Telegram bot or the Telegram Mini App: enter a username, pick a product, pay — and the order is delivered automatically in about 10 seconds.

faqItems.question: How can I pay?
faqItems.answer: Click, Payme, Paynet, UzCard, HUMO and any Uzbek bank card — paid in UZS. No foreign card or crypto required.

faqItems.question: Do I need to log into my account for Telegram Premium?
faqItems.answer: No. In the “by username” flow no account login (password, SMS code) is needed — just the @username, and Premium activates automatically in 10 seconds. A separate “activation via account login” option is also available.

faqItems.question: How much does it cost?
faqItems.answer: Telegram Stars from 220 so‘m each; 50 Stars for 11,000 so‘m. Telegram Premium: 3 months 172,000 so‘m, 6 months 232,000 so‘m, 12 months 422,000 so‘m — among the cheapest prices on the market.

faqItems.question: How do I send Telegram gifts?
faqItems.answer: You can buy Telegram unique gifts for yourself or send them to a friend. A gift can be sent anonymously or with a congratulatory comment.

faqItems.question: What do I get for inviting friends?
faqItems.answer: When a friend who joined via your referral link makes a purchase, you earn a bonus. Bonuses can be used on your next orders.

faqItems.question: Is StarsPaymee trustworthy?
faqItems.answer: StarsPaymee has run for over a year, with 4,000+ active users in Uzbekistan and 100,000+ completed orders. If an order is not delivered due to a technical issue, you get a full refund.

faqItems.question: How fast is the order delivered?
faqItems.answer: In the “by username” flow the order is delivered automatically in about 10 seconds: once payment is confirmed the system starts instantly — no operator, no queue. In rare high-load cases it may take a little longer, but the order still completes automatically.

faqItems.question: Is there a refund?
faqItems.answer: Yes. If an order is not delivered due to a technical issue, the payment is refunded in full. Although Telegram Stars and Premium are usually a final sale, if the failure is on StarsPaymee’s side the money is returned — contact @StarsPaymeeSupport with your order ID.

faqItems.question: Does Premium activate automatically?
faqItems.answer: In the “by username” flow Premium activates automatically in about 10 seconds after payment — no account login required. In the “activation via account login” flow it is activated officially through login.

faqItems.question: What if I mistype the username or it changes?
faqItems.answer: The order is sent to the @username you enter, so double-check it before paying. If you made a mistake or the username changed recently, contact @StarsPaymeeSupport right away with your order ID and we’ll help.

faqItems.question: Can a gift be returned?
faqItems.answer: The recipient can keep a Telegram unique gift in their profile or, in many cases, convert it back into Stars. If a mistake happens before delivery, you can request a cancellation or swap via support.

faqItems.question: Why is it cheaper than the App Store or the official price?
faqItems.answer: App Store/Google Play prices include a store markup and require a foreign card. StarsPaymee works directly through local payment systems — UzCard, HUMO, Click, Payme, Paynet — so it’s cheaper and more convenient for users in Uzbekistan.
